create_ManagedAttribute_with_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor that enforces a specific type when setting values on a class
create_ManagedAttribute_without_type: create a ManagedAttribute descriptor that allows any type when setting values on a class
test_ManagedAttribute_type_enforcement: test the ManagedAttribute descriptor raises ValueError when an incorrect type is assigned
review_ManagedAttribute_descriptor: review the ManagedAttribute class and its descriptor protocol methods for type enforcement behavior
refactor_ManagedAttribute_for_custom_cla: refactor the ManagedAttribute descriptor to manage attributes on a custom Runner or Reducer subclass
